title: Product Fourier functions are sign monomials
statement: For every natural number $n$, every multi-index $a:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{0,1\}$, and every sign-valued vector $x$ of length $n$, the product Fourier function indexed by $a$, evaluated at $x$, equals the sign monomial on the coordinates where $a$ is nonzero, evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a map from the length-$n$ index set to the two-element index set
$x$ is a sign-valued vector of length $n$
